Text (verbatim): "Ziran". Spell Z-i-r-a-n exactly, uppercase Z then lowercase i r a n, with a clearly dotted lowercase i. One word only below the frog, large and readable in an original friendly lightly humanist lettering style, consistent stroke weight and restrained personality.
Constraints: Original tree-frog identity with a recognizable amphibian silhouette and rounded toe pads. One coherent animal and one clean wordmark; works as a website logo and a community sticker.
